Подвал старой вентиляционной шахты пах с: The basement of the old ventilation shaft smelled of damp concrete, machine oil and ozone. Generators hummed behind the wall. Nine NE S27 dog tags lay on the table — the only link to the names their owners had left beyond the Perimeter.
Когда над Золотой Зоной завыли сирены, с: When sirens howled over the Golden Zone, the secret laboratories were already trying to breach the noosphere. An artificially amplified Super Emission threatened to spread far beyond the Perimeter. Its source was a reactor connected to a network of psi-emitters.
Manager расшифровал аварийные протоколы: Manager decoded the emergency protocols and assembled the squad. Silverhand, a veteran cyborg with a sparking metal arm, forced open the blast doors. Vlad took the first hits in his heavy exoskeleton. Shinigami guarded the rear, keeping mercenaries from striking the squad from behind.
Zuban проводил товарищей через аномальны: Zuban guided his companions through anomaly fields. Oleg held the narrow corridors with his SCAR-H. Qwtep carried power cells through ruined tunnels on his motorcycle. Myatus covered their crossings from concrete gantries with his VPR-338. Lexa stayed shoulder to shoulder with the others, his trusty M4 ready.
Они дошли до центрального зала, когда та: They reached the control hall with only seconds left on the timer. An energy mass pulsed behind the armoured glass. The reactor could no longer be stopped. Their only chance was to disconnect it before the pulse reached the noosphere.
Manager entered the emergency isolation codes. Silverhand held the jammed actuator with his metal arm. One by one, the psi-emitter indicators went dark. The Super Emission could no longer escape the complex, but all the accumulated energy remained inside the reactor.
Выигранных минут хватило на эвакуацию. В: The minutes they gained were enough to evacuate. A helicopter landed beside the shattered dome. Oleg and Vlad covered the boarding while Shinigami brought up the rear. Silverhand was the last aboard. Nine dog tags — nine survivors.
Когда вертолёт набрал высоту, комплекс и: As the helicopter climbed, the complex vanished in a brief white flash. The shock wave caught them over the forest, but the pilot held course. A boiling crater marked the reactor's grave. The world beyond the Zone survived the night.
Уже у безопасного периметра бортовой тер: Near the safe perimeter, the NE S27 onboard terminal glowed blue. A new coordinate grid appeared over the old route.
«Эвакуация зафиксирована. Получен новый: “Evacuation recorded. New signal received. To be continued…”
Бывшая звезда, теперь — призрак. Его пес: Once a star, now a ghost. His songs became a cry against the system.
Зона не прощает слабости. Сталь держит,: The Zone never forgives weakness. Steel holds, bullets speak, and we remain.
В Зоне мутанты меняются, а радиация оста: Mutants change in the Zone; radiation stays. Today I hunt them. Tomorrow the Zone hunts me.
Холодное пиво, горячая компания и аномал: Cold beer, good company — anomalies don't scare us! To the Zone, to life, to a good time!
Железо учит держать вес. Зона учит держа: Iron teaches you to carry weight. The Zone teaches you to carry pain. The SCAR-H settles the rest.
Мотор ревёт, сердце бьётся, дорога зовёт: The engine roars, the heart beats, the road calls. In the Zone, it's just you, your motorcycle and the will to arrive.
Мята глушит запах контрабанды, но Зона в: Mint hides the smell of contraband, but the Zone still knows what you're carrying.
Раньше я бил по мячу ради победы, теперь: I used to kick a ball for victory; now I carry a rifle for it. Success favours those who go all the way.
